name: humid_air_1691_windows_only_unchanged
description: Windows-only install (no fan): a humid night changes nothing; an open window pauses HVAC as it always did and no humid-air row is written
notes: Dew points (feels_like.dew_point_f): indoor 76.0F at 50.0% = 56.01F; outdoor 70.0F at 90.2% = 66.99F. Ceiling = default 65F (option On).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: a guard placed before the no-working-fan rule would report a refusal for a fan that does not exist. This is a control scenario: deleting the guard does not fail it, by design. There is no negative event assertion: a humid-air row at the 20:15 re-check would read nat_vent_humid_skip there (last decision wins), which the 20:15 'paused' assertion catches. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: no confusing 'fan not started' row on an install that has no fan.

Issue #1507 review: the outdoor humidity is paired with a dedicated outdoor temperature sensor (outdoor_temp_source sensor), as a real install needs for an outdoor dew point, so the coordinator-hosted golden tiers (P8 surfaces, promise parity, real HA) can run this scenario.

verdict.summary: Windows-only install (no fan): a humid night changes nothing; an open window pauses HVAC as it always did and no humid-air row is written

events.note: Summer evening, windows closed: outdoor cooler than the house, so free cooling is on offer by temperature.
Hot day, cool mode: with the windows closed the AC holds the band (no fan starts in a sealed house).
Five minutes later, same air: the engine re-asks the start question (paused-reactivation / idle-open re-check).

assertions.reason: Windows closed: the cool band is armed and the AC holds it.
Windows-only install (no fan): a humid night changes nothing; an open window pauses HVAC as it always did and no humid-air row is written
Rule 3: the open window pauses HVAC.
No fan to start: the no-working-fan rule answers first, so the re-check writes no humid-air refusal row (one would read nat_vent_humid_skip here).
